evals.name: layout-plan
evals.prompt: Without calling tools, propose where shared settings go for a repo with Source and Specs trees.
evals.expected_output: Root Directory.Build.props for shared properties, nested files that import the parent, targets in .targets.
assertions: Puts shared properties in root Directory.Build.props.
Uses GetPathAboveDirectoryBuildPropsFile import in nested files.

evals.name: props-vs-targets
evals.prompt: Without calling tools, explain why a condition using a project-defined property fails in Directory.Build.props.
evals.expected_output: Props evaluate before the project body; use targets or later evaluation.
assertions: Explains props import order is before the project file.
Suggests moving the logic to Directory.Build.targets.
